eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Allegan, MI; at 7:45 PM on AUG 11, 2026 Effective until 3:45 AM AUG 12, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Allegan Alert: ALLEGAN DISPATCH: WB I-196 closed at 45MM east of 60th St due to Large Sinkhole. Expect delays. Please use alternate route if possible. Detour will be exiting at M-40 Hwy and rerouted to SB US-31. Estimated closure length is 1 week. More updates to follow.
